are invested by the Secretary of the Treasury in interest-bearing Government securities (e.g., Treasury bills). All interest earned is credited directly to the LUST trust fund.

An annual report to Congress by the Secretary of the Treasury is required by section 9633(b)(1) of CERCLA, as amended.
